title: AIFA Baby Cloud
shortDec: Full-stack e-commerce app with catalog, cart, and secure checkout
description: Full-stack e-commerce application with a product catalog, cart management, and secure checkout. Firebase backs the data and file storage, and GitHub Actions runs the automated test and deploy workflow.

title: Score-wire
shortDec: Live sports scores with league, team, and status filters plus standings
description: Live sports scores platform with match filtering by league, team, and status, player statistics, and league standings. A GraphQL API integrates a third-party sports data source and falls back gracefully when rate limits are hit.

title: Fit-stack
shortDec: Comprehensive fitness tracking app with personalized workout plans and progress analytics
description: A full-stack fitness management application designed to help users achieve their fitness goals. Features include an extensive exercise library with video demonstrations, customizable workout routines, progress tracking with visual analytics, nutrition logging, workout history, goal setting with milestone tracking, and social features for sharing achievements. Secured with Supabase Auth and JWT tokens for user data protection.
